scenario: LTAC.2.3 — a rule's RHS admits an after-only form: one or more `after <dur>:` timer clauses with no preceding immediate action. The grammar's RHS body is an alternation `(action+ after_clause* | after_clause+)` so authors can express purely deferred work without inventing a no-op leading action. Pin: a rule with two `after` clauses and no immediate action parses and compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    T
->
    after 1_s:
        log info "first"
    after 5_s:
        log info "second"
